evidence.reason: The CLI entry point calls run() without a boundary handler. In the all-selector branch at line 1298, a wrong finding digest raises from select_job; because main only writes a result when run() returns, the exception escapes at line 1309 and no JSON artifact reaches stdout. That violates the I1 JSON-on-stdout contract and main's own 'every CLI path' guarantee. Wrapping run() and serializing the operational error with exit 1 is a minimal correctness fix, not a new requirement.
